Entries.Title: Elias's Note: Always Check the Wind
Entries.Text:
Always check the wind. It can lift you... or carry you far from your course.
— E.T.

Entries.Title: Elias's Note: The Sky Is a Map
Entries.Text:
Keep your eyes open, the sky is a map too.
— E.T.

Entries.Title: Elias's Note: Each Island
Entries.Text:
Each island has its own soul, its own weather, its own story.
— E.T.

Entries.Title: Elias's Note: Three Decades
Entries.Text:
Brindle Isle — a peaceful haven among the clouds. Its beauty is matched only by its mysteries. I have watched these skies for over three decades, and still, they hold secrets.
— E.T.

Entries.Title: Elias's Note: Cloud Edge
Entries.Text: The mist is thickest here. Be wary of sudden updrafts and shifting winds.

Entries.Title: Strange Maps
Entries.Text: Elias's maps don't agree with each other. The same island is drawn in three different places, each dated a few years apart. Notes in the margin: 'Not an error. It moved.'

Entries.Title: Skyfarer Sketches
Entries.Text: Pages of sketches: ancient fliers, brass instruments, Skyfarer markings. In the corner of one page, a small white creature with long feathered ears, drawn again and again from far away.

Entries.Title: Notes About Moving Islands
Entries.Text: Decades of weather logs. Wherever the wind behaves strangely, Elias marked it. One current is circled so many times the paper has worn through.

Entries.Title: Elias's Final Journal Entry
Entries.Text:
The maps are wrong. They always have been.
If you're reading this, look where the wind refuses to go.

Entries.Title: Piko's Notes: First Flight
Entries.Text:
(Kieran's note) He was sitting on the glider like he'd always belonged there. He won't leave. He chirps at the wind like it's talking back.

Piko — extremely helpful. Occasionally frustrating.

Entries.Title: Piko's Notes: Hidden Currents
Entries.Text: (Kieran's note) Piko found a current I couldn't see. His markings glowed when he did it. Where did he learn that?
